name: write_scoped_file
description: Call this tool to write or modify a single file within the repository. You must only execute this after reviewing the architecture ledger and explaining your plan to the orchestrator.

file_path.description: The exact path of the file to be written (e.g., 'backend/routers/chat.py').

code_content.description: The complete, raw code to be written to the file. Must adhere to junior-readable standards.

purpose.description: A one-sentence explanation of what this specific file accomplishes.
